versions.content: Variable lower and upper multiplicity in ECU Configuration Parameter definition Type: valid Description: The definition of the lower and upper multiplicity in the ECU Configuration Parameter definition shall be variable. Rationale: Through the lower and upper multiplicity the existence of elements in the ECU Configuration Parameter description is controlled. Making the bounds variable allows for freedom in the definition. Use Case: Make the decision whether parameters are mandatory or optional variant. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
